AGENDA
  ALHAMBRA YOUTH COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  Alhambra Public Library, Learning Center - 101 S. First Street, Alhambra, CA
  91801 Tuesday, November 14, 2023 - 6:00 PM

Commissioners  Members Ex Officio
Daniela Andrade  Michael Macias, Director of Parks & Recreation
Joselyn Cooper  Brie Houghton, Deputy Director
Marilyn Gonzalez  Rosalyn Rojas, Recreation Supervisor
Arabella Hernandez
Isabella Hernandez
Tatiana Hernandez
Iren Lam
Zachary Oliva
Jason Quach
Natalia Rosales
Andy Tiang
Chen Yu

We welcome you to the Youth Commission meeting.
If you wish to address the Commission during the meeting, please complete a speaker’s card and
give it to the secretary. The maximum time for addressing the Commission is five minutes. If
you wish to address the Commission on an item which appears on the agenda, your comments
will be heard during the Commission’s discussion of that item. If you wish to address the
Commission on a subject which does not appear on the agenda but related to recreation or
community service, you may make your presentation under agenda item VII. Please be advised
that the Commission cannot, under the State of California’s Ralph M. Brown Act, take action on
any item which does not appear on the agenda.
When making your presentation, please give your name and address for the record. Please make
your statement as brief as possible. Thank you.

I.  Roll Call
II.  Flag Salute
III.  Approval of the Minutes of the regular meeting of August 8, 2023.
Recommended Action: Approve the minutes of August 8, 2023. *Note: you must have
attended the meeting to vote on the minutes.
 IV.  Staff Report
V.  Oral Communications
VI.  Commission Orals
VII.  Adjournment
Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business described
hereinabove are on file in the Department of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 South
First Street, Alhambra, California, and are available for public inspection during regular office
hours which are 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior to the
meeting described herein, he or she may contact Mr. Michael Macias, Director of Parks &
Recreation, either in person at the Department of Parks & Recreation or by telephone at
626-570-5044.
minutes_text:
Minutes
  Alhambra Youth Commission
  November 14, 2023

The Alhambra Youth Commission was called to order at 6:05 PM on November 14, 2023, at the
Alhambra Civic Center Library, 101 South 1st Street, Alhambra, CA 91801

Commission Members Present: A. Hernandez, I. Hernandez, T. Hernandez, I. Lam, and J. Quach

Commission Members Absent: D. Andrade, J. Cooper, M. Gonzalez, Z. Oliva, N. Rosales, A. Tiang, and
C. Yu.

Also present: Deputy Director - B. Houghton, Supervisor - R. Rojas and Program Coordinator - F. Reyes

Flag Salute

Approval of Minutes
Commissioner T. Hernandez motioned to approve the Minutes of the August 8, 2023 meeting.
Commissioner I. Lam seconded the motion.

Staff Report
Supervisor R. Rojas referenced the August meeting regarding the commission’s proposal to create a flyer
in hopes of creating a toy drive for the Spark of Love event. Supervisor R. Rojas acknowledges that she
and President J. Quach made multiple attempts to contact commissioners on the subject; however, due to
a lack of meetings, the momentum to push the proposal was lost. Supervisor R. Rojas informed the
Commission she believes it’s now too late to move forward in this process. Supervisor R. Rojas suggests
tabling the toy drive for next year. Supervisor R. Rojas announces the Alhambra Chamber of Commerce
is putting together a new advisory group called the Alhambra Chamber of Commerce Youth Services and
Education Committee (ACC YSE Committee) and is extending invitations for members and volunteers to
join the ACC YSE Committee. Deputy Director B. Houghton announces the next meeting with the
Chamber is on December 5, between 1-2 PM. She acknowledges the timeframe may not be ideal for
members currently attending school but adds that the volunteers might be able to discuss that issue with
the ACC YSE Committee. President J. Quach asks for details about the ACC YSE Committee. Deputy
Director Houghton adds the new committee is dedicated to supporting the youth and community. The
ACC YSE Committee is similar to the Youth Commission, but more centered around volunteer work. She
would like at least two members to act as a liaison between the two committees to work together.
Commissioner T. Hernandez and President J. Quach volunteers, noted they prefer communications
through email due to schedule conflicts and or meetings after 4:00 PM. Deputy Director Houghton
handed out flyers regarding additional volunteer opportunities for the Rose Parade. Mentioning
information available on social media regarding registration and guidelines for decorating the Alhambra
City float. Some commission members’ school clubs are currently registered to volunteer for the Rose
Parade for different organizations but will reach out to more members to sign up for Alhambra’s city
float. Supervisor R. Rojas welcomes and introduces new commission members, Arabella Hernandez and
Isabella Hernandez. Commissioner T. Hernandez introduced herself to the new members, followed by I.
Lam and J. Quach.

Oral Communications
No cards were submitted for oral communications.

Commission Orals
President J. Quach believes the ACC YSE Committee is a great opportunity to collaborate with and
would like their committee to reach out to the Youth Commission for proposals to discuss for the next
Youth Commission meeting. Deputy Director Houghton announces that Hailee Reichwald is the
Community Relations Manager for the ACC YSE Committee. Supervisor R. Rojas confirms the members
 of the YSE Committee are currently all adults and for that reason, they are reaching out to the youth to
join.

Commissioner T. Hernandez inquired about the status of a new member submission by the name of
Montana Fox that was brought up in a previous meeting. Deputy Houghton relays updated status has yet
to be received in regards to M. Fox. Commissioner T. Hernandez agrees with President J. Quach in
regards to joining the YSE Committee as a great opportunity. She believes getting involved with other
branches of the city and potentially spreading awareness and working together will benefit both parties.
She agrees the ACC YSE Committee would need youth members because it is youth-centered.

Vice President Iren Lam brings up the old topic of creating a social media page for the Youth
Commission to help spread awareness. Deputy Director Houghton relays that the proposal has been
rejected, but suggests if the ACC YSE Committee and Youth Commission sees more exposure, she can
resubmit the social media proposal again. She adds, that having a social media platform for the committee
can be very difficult due to guidelines, and longevity of negative publishments. If needed, Alhambra’s
main social media portal can post on behalf of the Youth Commission or ACC YSE Committee.

President J. Quach inquiries about the potential Senior Volleyball event. Deputy Houghton advises she is
aware and has been receiving some interest from the public, but not enough to host a league. If she
receives more public interest, she will reconsider the proposal.

Adjournment
President J. Quach motioned for adjournment at approximately 6:28 PM. Seconded by Vice President I.
Lam.
